features.description: CI workload identity federation now shares the exchanged token across a job instead of re-exchanging it.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed workload identity federation in CI: processes in one job share the exchanged token instead of re-exchanging the single-use token; a rejected exchange fails fast with the server's message

features.description: Hook `if` conditions no longer over-match unrelated Bash commands containing command substitution.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed hook `if` conditions like `Bash(cat *)` firing on unrelated Bash commands when the command contained `$()` or backtick command substitution followed by more arguments

features.description: Sandbox network-violation details are now retained in Bash results even when the blocked command exits 0.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sandbox network-violation details being dropped from the Bash tool result when the blocked command still exited 0 (for example `curl` printing the proxy's 403 page)

features.description: Sandboxed Bash prompt no longer lists allowed network hosts, so Claude attempts requests and prompts for approval.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the sandboxed Bash tool prompt to no longer list allowed network hosts, so Claude attempts requests (and you can approve new hosts) instead of assuming unlisted hosts are blocked

features.description: /model, /fast, and /effort now execute immediately instead of queueing on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/model`, `/fast`, and `/effort` to also run immediately instead of queueing until the turn ends on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry and when telemetry is disabled

features.description: Cross-session messaging inbox socket now drops connections that send no complete line within 30 seconds.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the cross-session messaging inbox socket to close connections that send no complete line within 30 seconds; scripts posting to it should connect once their data is ready

features.description: macOS computer use now requires granting Finder access to click the desktop, Dock, or Finder windows.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed computer use on macOS so clicking the desktop, Dock, or a Finder window requires granting Finder via the access dialog, like any other app

features.description: New `modelPicker` setting curates the /model list with ordered, labeled model ids.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `modelPicker` setting: curate the `/model` picker with an ordered, labeled list of models (any id spelling, including Vertex/Bedrock ids), appended to or replacing the built-in lineup

features.description: New `promptCacheTtl` and `subagentPromptCacheTtl` settings control main vs subagent prompt cache lifetime.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `promptCacheTtl` and `subagentPromptCacheTtl` settings so API-key and cloud-provider users can keep a 1-hour prompt cache on the main conversation while subagents stay at 5 minutes

features.description: New `modelPricing` managed setting applies contracted rates to /cost, status line, and telemetry.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `modelPricing` managed setting so an organization's contracted per-model rates and discount multiplier are used for `/cost`, the status line, and telemetry cost figures instead of list price

features.description: /tasks and agent detail dialogs now expose the model and effort level each subagent ran on.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added the model (and effort level) each subagent ran on to `/tasks` and the agent detail dialogs

features.description: Sessions ending in plan mode now resume in plan mode for -p --continue/--resume when no permission mode is set
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sessions that ended in plan mode resuming outside plan mode in the VS Code extension, and in `claude -p --continue`/`--resume` with a permission prompt tool, when no permission mode was set

features.description: Notification hook now fires while the sandbox network-request permission prompt is pending
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the `Notification` hook not firing while the sandbox "Network request outside of sandbox" permission prompt is waiting

features.description: Bash permission checks now always require approval for malformed commands with a dangling && or || operator
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash permission checks to always require approval for malformed commands with a dangling `&&` or `||` operator

features.description: --strict-mcp-config sessions no longer prompt to approve .mcp.json servers they would never load
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `--strict-mcp-config` sessions prompting to approve `.mcp.json` servers they would never load, which left background sessions waiting at startup

features.description: Telemetry requests no longer send the third-party gateway API key to Anthropic; credentials go only to their own host
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed telemetry and metrics requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); a credential is now only sent to its own host

features.description: MCP tools marked requiresUserInteraction no longer offer a don't-ask-again option that wrote an ignored allow rule
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP tools marked `requiresUserInteraction` still offering "Yes, and don't ask again" in their permission prompt; the option wrote an allow rule the tool then ignored

features.description: /cd now applies the new directory's settings, hooks, .mcp.json servers, skills, and agents immediately
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `/cd`: the new directory's project settings, hooks, `.mcp.json` servers (behind the usual approval prompt), skills, and agents now take effect right after the move instead of on `--resume`

features.description: A subagent hitting maxTurns now returns output marked partial with a hint to continue via SendMessage
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved subagent results: a subagent that stops at its `maxTurns` limit now returns its output marked as partial, with a hint to continue it via `SendMessage`, instead of appearing finished

features.description: Claude can now start /code-review itself on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/code-review` so Claude can also start it on its own on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, through the Claude apps gateway, and when telemetry or non-essential traffic is disabled

features.description: /goal idle sessions now start at most three background-work check-ins per goal until the next user message
features.reference_changelog_line: `/goal`: Changed idle sessions to start at most three check-ins on long-running background work per goal; your next message allows three more

features.description: claude install and claude update defer a pending managed-settings consent prompt to the next interactive session
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `claude install` and `claude update` to defer a pending managed-settings consent prompt to the next interactive session instead of prompting mid-command

features.description: The command sandbox's filesystem configuration now respects --setting-sources
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the command sandbox's filesystem configuration not respecting `--setting-sources`

features.description: Startup warning for Bash allow rules with a wildcard before the subcommand, which also match inserted options
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a startup warning for Bash allow rules with a wildcard before the subcommand (e.g. `Bash(git * main)`), since they also match options inserted before the subcommand

features.description: /permissions gains an Auto mode tab for viewing and editing auto mode classifier rules
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an Auto mode tab to `/permissions` for viewing and editing auto mode classifier rules

features.description: OTel plugin events: plugin_id_hash reflects the real marketplace and enabled_via reports admin-install
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed OpenTelemetry plugin events for plugins synced from claude.ai: `plugin_id_hash` now reflects the plugin's real marketplace, and `enabled_via` is `admin-install` for admin-installed plugins

features.description: Sub-agents surviving a first-call model 404 by using the session fallback model chain, with richer error detail
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sub-agents dying on a first-call model 404: they now use the session's fallback model chain, and the error returned to the parent includes the error type, status, request id, and model

features.description: Hook or background agent output of megabytes no longer overflows the conversation and wedges the session
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a hook or background agent that printed megabytes of error output being able to overflow the conversation and wedge the session on "Prompt is too long"

features.description: Bash sandbox cleanup no longer deletes a dotfile-managed ~/.claude/settings.json symlink repointed outside writable area
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the Bash sandbox's after-command cleanup deleting a dotfile-managed `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink (nix/home-manager, stow) when it is repointed outside the sandbox's writable area

features.description: /compact and Summarize from here in --agent sessions now summarize under the conversation's own system prompt
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `/compact` and "Summarize from here" in sessions started with `--agent` summarizing under the default system prompt instead of the conversation's own

features.description: Unbounded memory growth fixed when a hook or background task output file cannot be written; file notes lost output
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed unbounded memory growth when a hook's or background task's output file could not be written; the file now notes where output was lost

features.description: Version-less marketplace plugin live cache is no longer deleted and recreated on second-scope install
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a version-less marketplace plugin's live cache directory being deleted and recreated on a second-scope install, which could disrupt a running session using it

features.description: Plugin marketplace rejects names with control or invisible characters and escapes marketplace-supplied output text
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved plugin marketplace hardening: names containing control or invisible characters are rejected, and marketplace-supplied text in `/plugin` and `claude plugin` output is escape-safe

features.description: Claude is now told when a configured MCP server failed to connect on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or telemetry-off sessions
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry sessions (and any with telemetry disabled): Claude is now told when a configured MCP server failed to connect, instead of concluding its tools don't exist

features.description: Sonnet 5 default auto-compact window raised to the full 1M context, compacting near 967K instead of 934K tokens
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed Sonnet 5's default auto-compact window to its full 1M context, so sessions on the 1M window now auto-compact at about 967K tokens instead of about 934K

features.description: Rendered markdown links to network/automounter paths or with control/invisible characters now render as plain text
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed terminal hyperlinks in rendered markdown: link targets that point at a network or automounter path, contain a control character, or lead with an invisible character now render as plain text

features.description: Analytics stays off from startup when managed settings force gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is configured
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed analytics to stay off from startup, not only after login, when managed settings force gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is configured

features.description: Organization sign-in enforcement exits at start when managed settings cannot be read, ignoring host or per-user settings
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed organization sign-in enforcement to exit at start when the administrator's managed settings cannot be read, even if host-supplied or per-user Windows registry settings exist

features.description: New /claude-api cost-optimize subcommand profiles Claude API spend and works through cost levers one change at a time
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/claude-api cost-optimize` to profile an existing project's Claude API spend and work through cost levers (caching, token hygiene, batch, effort, model choice) one measured change at a time

features.description: New SendFeedback tool drafts feedback reports for /feedback, disabled via the feedbackDrafts setting
features.reference_changelog_line: Added the `SendFeedback` tool: when something goes wrong in a session, Claude can draft a feedback report for you to review and send from `/feedback` (turn off with the `feedbackDrafts` setting)

features.description: spinnerTipsOverride gains structured entries plus tipsFile and label so orgs can rotate their own tips
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}` entries, `tipsFile`, and `label` to `spinnerTipsOverride`, so organizations can rotate their own tips alongside the built-in ones

features.description: The /claude-api skill now covers Admin API surfaces including members, invites, workspaces, keys, WIF, and CMEK
features.reference_changelog_line: Updated the `/claude-api` skill with Admin API coverage (organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, rate limit reports, workload identity federation, CMEK)

features.description: claude agents no longer skips the workspace trust prompt when the CI environment variable is set.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude agents` skipping the workspace trust prompt when the `CI` environment variable is set

features.description: Invalid PermissionRequest/PreToolUse hook answers now surface as a named hook schema error instead of hanging.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed background sessions waiting silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer: the `claude agents` row now names the hook and the schema error

features.description: Hook stdout that looks like JSON but fails to parse is now a hook error, not silently treated as plain text.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed hooks silently treating a stdout `{…}` object that isn't valid JSON as plain text; it's now reported as a hook error with the parse message

features.description: Project .mcp.json claude.ai connector entries no longer display under the trusted claude.ai heading in /mcp.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `/mcp` listing a project `.mcp.json` entry that declares the claude.ai connector type under the trusted "claude.ai" heading; it now appears under its real scope

features.description: MCP servers using headersHelper for Authorization now re-run the helper and retry on 401 instead of OAuth discovery.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP servers whose `headersHelper` supplies the `Authorization` header falling into OAuth discovery on a 401 instead of re-running the helper and retrying the call as documented

features.description: Cloud sessions no longer upload uncommitted prod.env, *.tfvars, or swap/temp/backup copies of credential files.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `/ultrareview` and locally seeded cloud sessions uploading uncommitted edits to `prod.env`-style and `*.tfvars` files, or to editor swap, temp, and backup copies of credential files (e.g. `key.pem.tmp`, `id_rsa.swo`); they now stay on your machine

features.description: An invalid crossSessionInbound value now warns and holds messages, or is refused outright under managed settings.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed an invalid `crossSessionInbound` value being silently ignored: it now warns and holds cross-session messages (user settings) or refuses them (managed settings) until fixed

features.description: Workflow tool description shrank to ~1k tokens; script-writing reference moved to a bundled workflow-authoring skill.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved the Workflow tool's prompt footprint: its description is now about 1k tokens instead of 5.7k, with the script-writing reference moved into a bundled `workflow-authoring` skill

features.description: Client timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved managed settings: client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt

features.description: /loop self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are now always available, including Bedrock/Vertex/Fo
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/loop`: self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are now always available, including on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry

features.description: In Linux user namespaces, root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed cross-session messaging in Linux user namespaces: root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories

features.description: SendMessage from a subagent now reports that replies land in the parent session's conversation, not the subagent.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `SendMessage` from a subagent to another session: the result now notes that any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to the subagent

features.description: New claude self-hosted-runner --client-label flag overrides the label the runner registers with.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>` (or `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`) to override the label the runner registers with (default: hostname)

features.description: New /usage-credits command lets Enterprise members request a higher usage limit from their admin.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/usage-credits` for Enterprise organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials, so members can request a higher usage limit from their admin

features.description: SendMessage/ListAgents cross-session messaging now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and with telemetry disabled.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added cross-session messaging (`SendMessage` / `ListAgents`) between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled

features.description: New --restricted / CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED strips execution tools, confines file tools, and refuses bypassPermissions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `--restricted` (or `CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED=1`): removes the built-in tools that run commands or code and `WebFetch` (unless named in `--tools`), keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses `bypassPermissions`, and ignores user, project and local settings files

features.description: Agent frontmatter accepts experimental.cacheTtl (5m or 1h) as a per-agent prompt cache TTL.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter: a per-agent prompt cache TTL used when no subagent TTL setting is configured

features.description: /doctor and /status now report server-managed settings load failures or why they were not fetched.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added server-managed settings diagnostics: a startup warning when the settings fail to load, and a `/doctor` and `/status` line explaining a load failure or why they weren't fetched (Bedrock/Vertex/third-party provider, custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)

features.description: New desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays setting caps the transcript-cleanup exemption for desktop-written sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Claude Desktop and Cowork sessions disappearing after 30 days: the transcript cleanup now keeps desktop-written sessions while they are in the app (unless org policy manages retention); the new `desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays` setting caps the exemption
